title: '6-to-1' Shopping Method Could Help You Save Money
paragraphs: With food prices increasing around the world, many people are looking for ways to save money when they shop.
And some people have been looking to something called the "6-to-1" shopping method. New York chef Will Coleman first shared this system in a TikTok video in 2024, and it has since gone viral.
The idea is simple: when you go shopping, buy six vegetables, five fruits, four proteins, three carbohydrates, two sauces or spreads, and one "fun" item. This should make at least six full meals.

Not only does this help you eat healthier food, having a structure for your shopping helps stop you from buying things impulsively — while having a plan helps make sure that you use everything you buy.
Having a system also helps you finish shopping faster. And having little room for highly processed food and snacks means you have to think carefully about the treats you want to give yourself.

The fruits and vegetables can be fresh or frozen — and can also be used for smoothies! For protein, you might choose chicken or beans, while rice or potatoes might be your carbohydrates. You could get a pasta sauce or a spread like hummus, and perhaps choose some chocolate as your treat.
However, before you even go to the supermarket, Coleman says you should start by checking what you already have, and then plan out your meals for the week.
Some people who have tried his method say it has helped them take their weekly grocery bills from around $85 to about $45. Though others say they've saved less.
So, will the 6-to-1 method make your next shopping trip cheaper? Possibly — but even if it doesn't help you save money, it can help you make more careful choices about what you buy!
